summary: Manulife Financial Corporation filed a Form 6-K with the SEC, attaching its amended Code of Business Conduct and Ethics, effective August 4, 2026. The filing is a routine corporate governance disclosure, not a special-situation event. It details ethical standards, compliance training, conflict-of-interest policies, and legal obligations, reflecting an annual review. No financial terms, transactions, or strategic actions are involved. The filing lists the exhibit and signatures by the Assistant Corporate Secretary. This is an ordinary current report with no relevance to acquisitions, divestitures, restructurings, or other special-situations categories; it is best classified as None.
